title: 第210章 考验法令第209章 意外大哥
slug: 镇守魔教圣女我一天涨一年功力
lines: 林琬的大哥？
陈然心念飞转，脑海中迅速闪过关于林家的一些传闻。
京城四大世家，林家。
作为整个京城内最庞大的几个顶级势力之一，
一举一动都能牵扯着京城众多百姓的命脉。
而林琬作为林家这一代唯一的嫡女，可以说是真正的掌上明珠，被整个林家捧在手心里惯着。
二哥林盛是个武痴，性子直来直去。
倒是这位大哥林修，字如其人独爱修身养性，极少在外界露面，传闻中是个深居简出的厉害人物。
没想到，今天竟然特意在藏武阁等自己。
“原来是林大哥。”
陈然很快回过神，拱手行了一礼。
“不必拘礼。”
林修摆了摆手，转身走向旁边的一处茶座。
“坐下陪我喝杯茶吧。”
陈然没有推辞，走过去在对面坐下。
林修亲自提壶，给他倒了一杯茶。
茶水清澈，香气扑鼻，仅仅是喝上一口，就感觉体内的气血蠢蠢欲动。
陈然有些吃惊，虽然效果很微弱，但是他还是能感受到气血缓缓增长了一点。
这壶茶水竟然对于他这个归真境修士都有些作用，林家果然是资源通天的世家豪门。
林修笑着开口：
“这壶茶水对你来说很有用，等结束后，我送你两罐回去泡着喝。”
“昨夜听老二提起你，说你根骨差了些，但天赋悟性都极为惊人，光是在天牢一个人修炼就能修炼到如此境界……”
林修端起茶杯，轻轻吹了吹热气。
“今日一见，老二倒是难得没夸大其词。”
“林大哥谬赞了，我不过是运气好，瞎练了几年。”
林修笑了笑，不置可否。
他放下茶杯，目光落在陈然身上，语气仿佛只是闲话家常。
“陈然，你对林家怎么看？”
“或者说，你对婉儿在六扇门当差，以及现在的镇魔司，有什么看法？”
来了。
陈然心头微动，这恐怕才是林家大少的考验。
他放下茶杯，神色平静。
“林大哥说笑了。”
“我只是天牢里的一个小狱监，拿朝廷俸禄，混口饭吃。”
“家国大事，哪是我这种升斗小民敢妄自非议的。”
林修哈哈一笑。
“你倒是滑头。”
“不过这里没有外人，你既然是婉儿的心上人，未来咱们就是一家人。”
content_en:
Lin Wan's eldest brother?
Chen Ran's thoughts were racing, and some rumors about the Lin family flashed through his mind.
The Lin family is one of the four major aristocratic families in Beijing.
As one of the largest top forces in the entire capital,
Every move can affect the lives of many people in the capital.
As the only legitimate daughter of this generation of the Lin family, Lin Wan can be said to be the real apple of their eye, and is held in the palm of the hands of the entire Lin family.
The second brother Lin Sheng is a martial arts fanatic with a straight-forward temper.
On the other hand, this eldest brother, Lin Xiu, is said to be a man who only loves to cultivate his moral character and rarely appears in the outside world. According to rumors, he is a powerful person who lives in a reclusive way.
Unexpectedly, he would wait for me at the Cangwu Pavilion today.
"It turns out to be Brother Lin."
Chen Ran quickly came to his senses and bowed with his hands in hand.
"No need to be formal."
Lin Xiu waved his hand, turned around and walked to a nearby teahouse.
"Sit down and have a cup of tea with me."
Chen Ran didn't refuse, walked over and sat down opposite.
Lin Xiu carried the pot himself and poured him a cup of tea.
The tea is clear and fragrant. Just one sip makes you feel the energy and blood in your body are ready to stir.
Chen Ran was a little surprised. Although the effect was very weak, he could still feel his energy and blood slowly increasing a little.
This pot of tea actually has some effect on him, a monk in the Return to True Realm. The Lin family is indeed a wealthy family with vast resources.
Lin Xiu smiled and said:
"This pot of tea will be very useful to you. When it's over, I'll send you two cans back to drink."
"Last night I heard my second brother talking about you, saying that you are a bit weak, but your talent and understanding are extremely amazing. You can reach such a state just by practicing alone in Tianlao..."
Lin Xiu picked up the tea cup and blew the hot air gently.
"When we meet today, it's rare that the second child doesn't exaggerate."
"Brother Lin is ridiculous. I just got lucky and practiced blindly for a few years."
Lin Xiu smiled and was noncommittal.
He put down the tea cup and looked at Chen Ran, his tone seemed to be just chatting.
"Chen Ran, what do you think of the Lin family?"
"In other words, what do you think of Wan'er's work as an errand at the Six Gates and now the Demon Suppression Division?"
Coming.
Chen Ran's heart moved slightly. This might be the test for the eldest son of the Lin family.
He put down the tea cup and looked calm.
"Brother Lin is joking."
"I'm just a small prison warden in the sky prison. I get a salary from the imperial court and make ends meet."
"How can a humble citizen like me dare to criticize the important matters of our family and country?"
Lin Xiu laughed.
"You're quite cunning."
"But there are no outsiders here. Since you are Wan'er's sweetheart, we will be a family in the future."
